runs.text:
Tal Barr's musical path began with performances at Celtic music festivals, before she recorded her debut album. Her rendition of the Vikings’ featured song If I Had a Heart has since reached millions of views on YouTube.

In 2023, she gave life to The Elders, a musical exploration deeply rooted in ancient feminine spirituality. Its sound blends Celtic and traditional European instruments, haunting vocals, shamanic rhythms and the four elements.

The single Mothers embodies the archetype of the Great Mother, a symbolic figure of prehistoric cultures representing the cycles of life, and seeks to conjure a primal memory from before recorded history, before the rise of organized religion and modern civilization.

Tal is a mother of two beautiful wild earthlings.
